description: A short acknowledgement message, identifying what is being acknowledged rather than carrying data.

attributes.name: type
description: What is being acknowledged, e.g. a job report or a signal. Dispatched on by the receiver.

attributes.name: id
description: Primary key of the acknowledged thing, usually a job id.

attributes.name: id2
description: Secondary key, usually an array task id.

attributes.name: str
description: String key, used where the acknowledged thing is named rather than numbered.
